model_limits: Continuum cylinder approximation, stationary diffusion formally; optional common conductance multipliers are sensitivities.
Local latent-heat geometry, no internal crystal conduction or substrate heat sink; no molecular-jump corrections.
The declared width/a <= 0.1 thin-rim range is a conservative analysis choice for the source narrow-ring asymptote, not a measured physical boundary.
No off-edge hollow field, cavity-depth state, rim evolution, finite vapor reservoir, aggregation or fracture in this component.

equation_audit.finding: Printed h_a fit labels log10; the later archived implementation uses natural log. The latter agrees with the selected original numerical table to within 5.46%; no change to the pinned 2026 source was made. This records the source discrepancy without claiming a verified author correction.
